source_units.text: I will critique a pedestrian-street design in class.
Please create a focused preparation schedule for the design concepts.
The syllabus consists of "Crossing Visibility", "Kerb Ramps", "Pedestrian Desire Lines", "Footway Width"; each named topic needs a minimum of 25 minutes in total.
My study window closes on 2027-02-05; that date is still available.
I would prefer to encounter "Footway Width" early; treat that as a suggestion only, not a time requirement.
The total of all sessions on any one date must not exceed 60 minutes.
